{{Quote|Come on, Keldon, we have to get the droid set up with a continuous broadcast message before we collapse too. Then all we can do is wait&mdash;and hope.|Commander Astred rallies Keldon during the outbreak of Direllian Plague at their outpost|<ref name="QM" />}}
'''Keldon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[Medic/Legends|medic]] at the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Tiragga Alliance outpost|base]] on the [[Second moon of Tiragga|second]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Tiragga]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. When the base's personnel contracted the [[Direllian Plague]], Keldon was one of the last to be incapacitated. Along with [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Astred]], he set up a continuous broadcast message in an effort to enlist help from returning supply crews by directing them to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kirtania]] to procure [[Shiarha Root]] to treat the plague.

==Biography==
Keldon was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Medic/Legends|medic]] serving with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and was assigned to the small [[Tiragga Alliance outpost|outpost]] on the [[Second moon of Tiragga|second moon]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tiragga]]. Sometime during the war, the outpost's personnel contracted the [[Direllian Plague]], a fatal respiratory disease that could kill in [[Standard day/Legends|days]]. Twelve [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] after the plague struck, Keldon was the only medic capable of duty, and the base's [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droids]] had taken over caring for forty patient's in the sic bay, while another hundred or so were confined to quarters in an effort to stem the spread of the plague. Although suffering from the disease, Keldon's performed tests that confirmed the presence of the Direllian Plague, and informed the base [[Commander/Legends|commander]], [[Astred]], of his findings. He recommended sending someone to the nearby planet of [[Kirtania]] to acquire [[Shiarha Root]], and the aid of [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[T'Jaleq Kith'Araquia]], the noted [[Araquia]] scientist who first discovered the cure for the malady. Commander Astred agreed that someone needed to be sent, but refused to send any base personnel for fear that they would become too ill during the course of the mission to complete it. Instead, Astred and Keldon set up a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] to broadcast a continuous message and hope that one of the base's supply [[Starship/Legends|ships]] returned early enough to help them.<ref name="QM" />

{{RPG}}
Keldon was saved when a transport crew returning to the outpost picked up the message and immediately diverted to Kirtania, where they acquired the necessary Shiarha Root to manufacture a cure.<ref name="QM" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
An experienced medic, Keldon did not let the effects of the Direllian Plague interfere with his efforts to analyze and formulate a plan to deal with the crisis.<ref name="QM" />

==Behind the scenes==
Keldon appeared in ''[[The Quality of Mercy]]'', an [[Roleplaying game|RPG adventure]] written by [[Nicky Rea]] published in [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 1|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 1]] by [[West End Games]] in [[1995]]. Keldon can die during the adventure if the player characters take too long during their adventure on Kirtania. This article assumes that the player characters successfully completed the task as recommended.
